name: firestore-row-96-batch-commit-atomic
description: batch.commit() applies all queued writes atomically. Success path: queue 3 writes to 3 different docs (one set on a fresh doc, one update on a previously-set doc, one delete) and verify all 3 changes are present after a single commit. Failure path: a batch where one write targets a path OUTSIDE pyric_oracle/* — verify the whole batch rejects (no partial application: the previously-set doc still has its original value, the would-be-new doc never lands).
